name: jyu_face
desc: brown paint bear man, same image. Keep the head shape, the thick angular black eyebrows, the grumpy closed mouth, the muzzle, the nose, the ears, the body, the pose, the colors and the size exactly as they are. Change only the face surface and the eyes: both eyes become fully dark, solid glossy black-brown beads of paint, filled completely with dark color; the whole face becomes slick, wet and glistening like freshly poured paint, with bright glossy highlights on the brow, the bridge of the muzzle and the cheeks, and thin streaks of paint slowly oozing down the face.
